solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Lecturer in dean's chief role organised college accommodation

indicators.note: in places the lecturer's letter inside the rearranged letters
organised says the letters of the words before it are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A lecturer takes on a dean's main duties and sorts out where students will live.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organised' rearranges DEANS CHIEF ROLE; 'in' then slips L for lecturer into that mix.
explanation.definitionFit: A hall of residence is a building where a college houses its students, so it is lodging provided by the institution.

clue.text: Retreat raised suspicion, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the answer sounds like the phrase made from the preceding words

parts.note: raised means high and suspicion means doubt, giving the phrase high doubt

explanation.surface: Someone backed off after people grew suspicious, so the rumour goes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we hear' signals a homophone: HIGH DOUBT, said quickly, matches the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A retreat is a secluded refuge, a place to hide from pursuers.

clue.text: Subject, say, covered by story

indicators.note: covered by puts the short example word inside the word for a fib

parts.note: a story is a lie, a fib
say introduces an example, abbreviated eg

explanation.surface: A topic, for instance, gets buried in a tale someone tells.
explanation.definitionFit: In feudal terms a liege can be a vassal, a subject owing allegiance to a lord.

clue.text: Heading north, happen largely to manage ordinary Italian dish

indicators.note: in a down clue, heading north means the letters are read upwards, i.e. backwards
largely means most of the word, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: to happen is to occur
to boss is to manage, direct

explanation.surface: Instructions to take charge of a plain Italian meal while travelling north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'largely' trims OCCUR to OCCU; 'Heading north' turns OCCU + BOSS + O upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Osso buco is a Milanese stew of veal shanks braised with wine and vegetables.

clue.text: Criticism facing former president rejecting very celebrated artist

indicators.note: facing puts the criticism word in front of the next piece

parts.note: rap means a rebuke, criticism

indicators.note: rejecting says the very letter is thrown out of the president's name

parts.note: Vaclav Havel was president of Czechoslovakia and then the Czech Republic

explanation.surface: A former head of state comes under fire after rejecting a very famous painter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejecting' throws out the V of the former Czech president's name; 'facing' sets the criticism in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Raphael was a leading painter of the Italian High Renaissance, one of history's most famous artists.

clue.text: Smear party held by essentially dismal celebrity

indicators.note: held by puts the smear and party words inside the core letters
essentially picks the core, the middle letters of the word

parts.note: to tar is to smear, blacken
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A dismal celebrity is mud-slung at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Celebrity as a state of being famous is the same as star status.

clue.text: Abandon long depression

definitions.meaning: to abandon something is to get rid of it, throw it away
a long narrow trench dug in the ground, as for drainage

explanation.surface: Give up a long low spell of gloom.
explanation.definitionFit: A drainage trench is a long hollow, and to discard something is to jettison it.

clue.text: Fool gets cold on rowing boat reportedly

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: numb means unfeeling from cold

indicators.note: reportedly says the boat word is spelt as one that sounds the same

parts.note: a scull is a light rowing boat

explanation.surface: An idiot ends up chilled out on the water in a rowing boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reportedly' swaps SCULL for its sound-alike, the bony head case.
explanation.definitionFit: A dimwit or blockhead is a slow, stupid person.

clue.text: Piece of kitchen's laverbread to keep one enthralled

indicators.note: Piece of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A bit of seaweed bread from the kitchen is so good it holds you spellbound.
explanation.walkthrough: Laverbread is a Welsh delicacy made from seaweed.
explanation.definitionFit: Enthralled originally meant held in thrall, in bondage, so to keep someone so is to make them a slave.

clue.text: Look smart when turning face to East End crowd

indicators.note: turning means the combined letters are read backwards

parts.note: puss is slang for the face

indicators.note: in the East End of London, Cockneys drop their aitches

parts.note: a herd is a crowd

explanation.surface: Someone looks sharp when they turn to face a crowd in the East End.
explanation.walkthrough: 'East End' drops H from HERD to give 'ERD; 'turning' reverses PUSS + ERD.
explanation.definitionFit: To put on smart clothes for an occasion is to look smart.

clue.text: Value one's missed in novelist, one revered by Greeks

indicators.note: in puts the shortened value word inside the novelist

parts.note: Kingsley or Martin Amis, English novelists

indicators.note: missed says one letter is left out of the value word

parts.note: to rate is to value
a is one

explanation.surface: A worth that's missing in a novelist, someone the Greeks honoured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one's missed' reads as one is missed: 'missed' drops the A (one) from the value word, and 'in' sets the rest inside the novelist.
explanation.definitionFit: Artemis was the Greek goddess of the hunt, worshipped across ancient Greece.

clue.text: Accomplished person entertaining Arab off deck?

parts.note: over means finished, accomplished

indicators.note: entertaining means holding the Arab abbreviation inside the person word

parts.note: bod is slang for a person
Ar is an abbreviation for Arab or Arabic

explanation.surface: A talented host welcomes an Arab guest but leaves the deck.
explanation.definitionFit: Going over the side of a ship puts you off its deck and into the water.

clue.text: In which parasite might exist by a plant?

parts.note: a host is an organism on which a parasite lives

explanation.surface: Could a parasite live on a plant? The question invites a botanist's answer.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue reads like a biology question; only 'plant' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Hostas are shady garden perennials prized for their large leaves.

clue.text: Stock clothing in trendy film filming area held back

indicators.note: clothing means the outside letters, the ones that wrap round the word

parts.note: pic is short for picture, a film

indicators.note: held back means the city letters are reversed

parts.note: LA, Los Angeles, home of Hollywood

explanation.surface: Stock footage of trendy dress in a film, with the studio location shown in reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clothing' gives TY, the outsides of trendy; 'held back' turns LA to AL.
explanation.definitionFit: Stock as an adjective means standard or usual, as in a stock response.

clue.text: Cabinet responsibility if poor lot are to be transformed

indicators.note: to be transformed says the letters are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A minister's brief: deciding whether the lot of the poor is to change.
explanation.definitionFit: A government minister's area of responsibility is called their portfolio.

clue.text: Get hands, perhaps, to produce a lot of food? Certainly

indicators.note: a lot of means most but not all, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a meal is food taken at one sitting
sure means certainly

explanation.surface: Should you get your hands busy producing heaps of food? Absolutely.
explanation.walkthrough: Horses are sized in hands, four inches each, so finding a horse's height in hands is gauging it.
explanation.definitionFit: Finding a size in hands is gauging something, the hand being a unit for horses.

clue.text: Confident owner finally entering valuable property I have restricted

indicators.note: entering puts the last letter inside the property word

parts.note: an asset is a valuable possession

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word
restricted means shortened, as I have becomes the contraction

parts.note: I have contracts to I've

explanation.surface: A confident owner moves into a valuable property with limits on what he can do.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally' gives R; 'restricted' shortens I have to I'VE.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-assured person states their views firmly and forcefully.

clue.text: Risky possible outcome on course with car losing time

parts.note: on a golf course, par is a possible score for a hole

indicators.note: losing says the time letter is removed from the car

parts.note: a Lotus is a British sports car

explanation.surface: A dangerous result on the racecourse, with the car losing time.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests motor racing, but the course is a golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: Perilous and precarious, the state of something in danger.

clue.text: Speciality following appointment shown in letters

indicators.note: following puts the speciality word after the appointment word

parts.note: a post is a job, an appointment
one's bag is one's speciality, one's thing

explanation.surface: A specialist role after being appointed, as shown in the correspondence.
explanation.definitionFit: A postbag is the mail received, especially by a newspaper or public figure.

clue.text: Time inside extension

explanation.surface: Time spent indoors is extended.
explanation.definitionFit: A prison term is slang for a spell of time, and to pull something longer is to extend it.

clue.text: Curtail abuse by a Republican being prejudiced

indicators.note: curtail means cut off the tail, the last letter

parts.note: an insult is verbal abuse

explanation.surface: A bigoted Republican is told to cut down on the abuse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Curtail' cuts the last letter from INSULT, leaving INSUL.
explanation.definitionFit: Narrow-minded and inward-looking, like an island cut off from outside views.

clue.text: This month start to explore publicity as an alternative

parts.note: inst., short for instant, means this month in formal letters

indicators.note: start to picks the opening letter of the word

parts.note: an ad is an advertisement, publicity

explanation.surface: This month, try publicity as a different approach.
explanation.definitionFit: Meaning in place of something else, as a substitute.

clue.text: CV of New Yorker with degree came into play again

parts.note: in American English a CV is called a resume

explanation.surface: A New Yorker's job history with a degree on it gets back in the game.
explanation.definitionFit: To start again after a pause is to restart play, carry on.

clue.text: Mystics protected by pilgrims if usurped in retreat

indicators.note: in retreat says the hidden letters are read backwards
protected by says the answer sits inside these words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Mystics shelter pilgrims who have been ousted and are on retreat.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Mystics protected' as the definition, but 'protected by' is the hiding indicator; the definition is 'Mystics' alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Sufis are Islamic mystics seeking direct experience of God.

clue.text: Man getting support for notes

definitions.meaning: to man a place is to provide it with workers
the five lines on which music is written, also called a stave

explanation.surface: A man gets backing for his memos.
explanation.definitionFit: To supply with workers is to crew a place, and the musical stave holds written notes.

clue.text: Established skipper aboard jolly ship, originally offering facilities

indicators.note: aboard puts the established and skipper letters inside the marine

parts.note: a jolly is slang for a Royal Marine, RM
a roo, kangaroo, is a creature that skips and hops

indicators.note: originally picks the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: An established captain on a cheerful ship provides amenities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'skipper' is not a captain but a kangaroo; 'jolly' is a noun, a Royal Marine.
explanation.definitionFit: Facilities is a euphemism for lavatories, called restrooms in America.

clue.text: Fruit only in view in regular fashion

indicators.note: in regular fashion means taking every other letter

explanation.surface: Fruit seen only in view, in a regular way.
explanation.definitionFit: The olive is the small oily fruit of the olive tree.

clue.text: Labour politician harbouring a tendency principally for weight

indicators.note: harbouring means holding the a inside the politician's name

parts.note: Ed Balls, Labour shadow chancellor at the time

indicators.note: principally picks the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A Labour politician has a tendency mainly to throw his weight around.
explanation.walkthrough: Ed Balls was a prominent British Labour politician.
explanation.definitionFit: Ballast is heavy material carried to steady a ship, i.e. weight for stability.

clue.text: Tending to prefer cream?

parts.note: the cream is the pick of a group, so preferring it is favouring an elite rather than dairy

explanation.surface: Someone who likes cream with everything.
explanation.definitionFit: The belief that a select, superior few should lead or be favoured.

clue.text: Lose composure — an inexperienced diver shouldn't do it

definitions.meaning: to fly into a rage, lose control

definitions.text: an inexperienced diver shouldn't do it
definitions.meaning: a novice swimmer should stay in shallow water, not jump into the deepest part of the pool

explanation.surface: Losing one's cool, as a beginner at the pool should not.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for a sudden loss of temper literally describes plunging into the deepest water.
